sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《High sensitivity-C-reactive protein variability and risk of cancer incidence: A longitudinal prospective cohort study cancer》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】Consequently, the present study aimed to explore the association between high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) variability and the occurrence of cancer.

【Abstract · abstract-1-7】The results demonstrated that a high CV of hs-CRP was significantly associated with reduced cancer risk [hazard ratio (HR), 0.84; 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.75-0.94].

evidence.text: Consequently, the present study aimed to explore the association between high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) variability and the occurrence of cancer.
The results demonstrated that a high CV of hs-CRP was significantly associated with reduced cancer risk [hazard ratio (HR), 0.84; 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.75-0.94].
